panel.title: Shared links
panel.intro: Every link that lets someone without an account reach content of this site. Revoking a link clears its key: the address stops working immediately.
panel.introLive: A link to published content is served from the live workspace, so clearing its key takes effect once that change is published. Until then the link stays listed as "Revoked, still live" and the action on its row publishes the revocation.
panel.none: No content of this site is shared.
panel.notOnSite: This site does not have the Content Sharing module enabled.
panel.error: The links could not be read.
panel.noExpiryHint: No expiry date: this link does not work until it has one.

review.title: Share for external review
review.intro: Anyone holding this link sees "{{name}}" as it stands now, unpublished changes included, without an account, until the link expires.
review.everythingPage: The reviewer sees every unpublished change on this page, not only yours. Links on it lead to pages they may not be able to open.
review.everything: The reviewer sees every unpublished change on this content, not only yours.
review.error: This content could not be read.
review.failed: The link could not be saved. You may not have the rights to share this content.
